This offseason will be a significant one for the organization as it looks to put together the right roster for a turnaround. Whether it is the bullpen or the starting rotation, New York is going to need to add pitching this offseason. Upgrading the starting rotation remains a top priority, but the Mets also need to revamp their bullpen after trading away four relievers at the deadline,” SI’s Tommy Kelson wrote.
